summary: A mixed legal and business day with three judicial appointments and significant regulatory developments. Key focus on Reliance's IPO approval, retail sector dynamics, and treasury market movements.

bullets.text: Supreme Court Collegium recommends three High Court Chief Justices for J&K, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan High Courts.
Markets regulator approves Jio Platforms' $3.8 billion IPO; company receives regulatory nod for public listing.
Government discussing import duty cut on gold and silver after higher tariffs fail to curb imports, fuel grey market.
Zomato bans analogue dairy dishes on platform, implements zero-tolerance policy against synthetic food products.
Meta removes fraudulent porn-app ads after India alerts authorities; apps directed users to phishing websites.
